    1. onNewPaperPublished(String, ResearchPaper)

Interface JournalObserver

All Known Implementing Classes:
Admin, Employee, GraduateStudent, Manager, ResearcherDecorator, Student, Teacher, TechSupportSpecialist, User
public interface JournalObserver
Observer interface for research journal subscriptions (Observer pattern). Any user can implement this to be notified when a new paper is published.
